children: U.S. Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins said on Wednesday that the Department of Agriculture is preparing to reopen a New Mexico port to livestock trade next week after it was closed because of New World screwworm.
"We're getting ready to reopen that New Mexico port next week," Rollins said in remarks at the National Association of State Departments of Agriculture conference in Portland, Maine.
